hero.title: Create with EsAI. Earn from your audience.
hero.sub: Get up to {{max}}% of every payment made by the users you bring in — on an ongoing basis.

how.title: How it works
how.step1_text: Tell us about yourself and add your social media.
how.step3_title: Get your level and partner link
how.step3_text: Once approved, you get a personal dashboard.
how.step4_text: Create content with EsAI, tell your audience about the service and earn Creator Credits for being active.
how.step5_text: Use your personal link or promo code.
how.step6_text: Get an ongoing commission on payments from the users you brought in.

commission.title: Commission
commission.text: The commission is ongoing: you get your percentage not only on the first purchase but on every later paid order of the user you brought in. The commission applies as long as the referral link between you exists and the creator account is not blocked.

credits.title: Creator Credits
credits.text1: Creator Credits are internal EsAI credits that the team may grant to active program members for quality content, activity and results.
credits.text2: The amount and frequency of grants are decided individually by the EsAI team. Credits can be used inside EsAI, but cannot be withdrawn as money, sold or transferred to another user.

levels.title: Level-up requirements
levels.text: The figures are counted over your whole time in the program, not per month. Once they are reached, the dashboard shows the mark “Level requirements met”. Upgrades are not automatic — the final decision is made by an EsAI administrator.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.main: Payouts are in USDT only, on the {{network}} network. The minimum withdrawal is {{min}} USDT. No fee is taken from payouts: request 50 USDT and you receive 50 USDT.
payouts.hold_one: A commission becomes available for withdrawal {{count}} day after it is accrued.
payouts.hold_other: A commission becomes available for withdrawal {{count}} days after it is accrued.
payouts.no_tariff: You don't need to buy a plan to take part.
